name: Reactor Deck
narrativeOnEnter: Everything red. A figure slumped at the control station — Kovalev. Sequence panel unlocked. Safety manual on the console.

action.text:
MERIDIAN STATION — REACTOR SAFETY MANUAL
Section 7: Emergency Stabilisation Sequence

In the event of a thermal runaway warning:
Press the sequence panels in this exact order:

  B → D → A → C → B
  (Panel 2, Panel 4, Panel 1, Panel 3, Panel 2)

This triggers a controlled coolant flush.
Do NOT deviate from this order — incorrect sequence
will accelerate thermal cascade.

Kovalev. Alive — barely. Pulse weak. Collapsed after unlocking the sequence.

A note in his hand:

'SRRs are in the reactor housing. Stabilisation triggers a thermal spike — wipes the buffer.
AXIOM wanted to extract via MERIDIAN-3. Do not let them dock.

CALLISTO: 148.350 MHz. Tell them the buffer is clean.

Sequence: B,D,A,C,B.

I'm sorry I couldn't finish it.
— Dmitri Kovalev'

His eyes open. He looks at you. Nods. Closes them.

Reactor housing. Temperature: 847°C (CRITICAL — threshold 900°C)

At the base — six small black devices. Δ mark. Wired into the network bus.
All LEDs red: BUFFER FULL.

Synaptic Response Recorders. One per crew member. 63 days of data.

The thermal spike will hit the buffer first. Kovalev planned this.
Minutes, not hours. Complete the sequence.
